q_001.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TotalSales DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_001.answer: The top five best‑selling genres are Rock ($826.65), Latin ($382.14), Metal ($261.36), Alternative & Punk ($241.56) and TV Shows ($93.53).

q_002.sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC';
q_002.answer: AC/DC’s albums are “For Those About To Rock We Salute You” and “Let There Be Rock”.

q_004.sql:
SELECT mt.Name AS MediaType, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM MediaType mt
JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_004.answer: The most popular media type is “MPEG audio file,” with 3,034 tracks.

q_005.sql:
SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName
ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 1;
q_005.answer: Jane Peacock has the most customers assigned to her, with 21 customers.

q_006.sql:
SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Playlist AS p

q_008.sql:
SELECT Invoice.BillingCountry AS Country,
       AVG(Invoice.Total) AS AvgTotal
FROM Invoice
GROUP BY Invoice.BillingCountry
ORDER BY AvgTotal DESC;
q_008.answer: The average invoice total by billing country, from highest to lowest, is: Chile $6.66, Ireland $6.52, Hungary $6.52, Czech Republic $6.45, Austria $6.09, Finland $5.95, Netherlands $5.80, India $5.79, USA $5.75, Norway $5.66, Germany $5.59, France $5.57, Sweden $5.52, Portugal $5.52, Brazil $5.43, Canada $5.43, and United Kingdom, Spain, Poland, Italy, Denmark, Belgium, Australia, and Argentina each at $5.37.

q_009.sql:
SELECT CustomerId, FirstName, LastName, TotalSpending,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC) AS Rank
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName,
           IFNULL(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS TotalSpending
    FROM Customer c
    LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
) 
ORDER BY TotalSpending DESC
LIMIT 5;
q_009.answer: The top five spenders are Helena Holý (Customer 6) with $49.62 (rank 1), Richard Cunningham (Customer 26) with $47.62 (rank 2), Luis Rojas (Customer 57) with $46.62 (rank 3), and Ladislav Kovács (Customer 45) and Hugh O'Reilly (Customer 46) each with $45.62 (tied for rank 4).

q_010.sql:
SELECT a.Name AS ArtistName,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS GenreCount
FROM Artist a
JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 3
ORDER BY GenreCount DESC, ArtistName;
q_010.answer: Iron Maiden has tracks in 4 different genres.
